claims.statement: Data and config directories come from platformdirs and can be overridden with SEMPROPOS_DATA_DIR and SEMPROPOS_CONFIG_DIR.

The data directory holds index.db, the tool embedding matrix and id files, index.meta, last_indexed, and the tldr, model, embedding, and binary caches; config.toml lives in the config directory and legacy intelligence.toml is read only when config.toml is absent.
Embedding and index format revisions are both 3 and are recorded in index.meta for compatibility checks.
Supported synthesis providers are local_gguf, ollama, openai_compatible, and tier0; supported embedding providers are fastembed_local, ollama, and none, with tier0 and fastembed_local as defaults.

SynthesisConfig carries provider, model, base URL, three key sources, timeout, think, temperature, max_tokens, keep_alive, stop, n_ctx, n_gpu_layers, and threads; EmbeddingConfig separately carries provider, model, base URL, timeout, and lazy_fallback.
Configuration loading tolerates a missing or malformed TOML file, normalizes provider names, ignores wrongly typed fields, and falls back to role defaults.
Saving configuration strips None values and writes atomically through atomic_write_text.

Query-time index validation rejects a missing or unparsable metadata file, a present non-complete status, an index revision mismatch, a missing database, and an unsupported stored embedding provider; for non-none embeddings it also rejects revision, model, dimension, configured provider or model mismatches, and a missing tool embedding file.
API keys resolve in order from the configured environment variable, then the system keyring under service sempropos, then plaintext configuration.
The OpenAI-compatible provider reads SEMPROPOS_OPENAI_BASE_URL and SEMPROPOS_OPENAI_API_KEY and defaults its base URL to https://api.openai.com/v1 when a key is present.

Runtime files live under SEMPROPOS_RUNTIME_DIR, then <data>/run when SEMPROPOS_DATA_DIR is set, then $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/sempropos, and otherwise <data>/run; the daemon uses sem.sock, sem.pid, and sem.lock.
The configuration has daemon and indexing sections controlling daemon enablement, auto-start, idle timeout, tldr and completion ingestion, --help probing, and the help probe timeout.
The curated local GGUF catalog provides tiny, balanced, and quality tiers with model ids qwen2.5-coder-0.5b, qwen2.5-coder-1.5b, and qwen2.5-coder-3b.
